name: BANBEIS institution lists (EIIN registry, e-survey 2024) — Mymensingh Division
organization: Bangladesh Bureau of Educational Information and Statistics (BANBEIS), Ministry of Education
attribution: Source: BANBEIS (banbeis.gov.bd), institution lists based on e-survey 2024
notes: National XLSX lists (school; college & school-and-college; madrasa; government technical; independent technical; public/private university; professional) published on banbeis.gov.bd file pages (object-store links), filtered to DIVISION_NAME=Mymensingh and deduplicated by EIIN; same collector and rules as BANBEIS_INST_RAJ_2026. Fields: division, district, thana, institute type, education level, EIIN, name (English only), post office, e-mail, management, MPO status, for-whom, geographical position, area status. No coordinates, no phone numbers, no Bangla names. source_url per row is the BANBEIS Institute Search detail page for that EIIN (its /api/ is disallowed by robots.txt, not crawled). No education-board cross-check for this division. Licence not stated on the portal.
